served_text.reason-0001: How many integers from 1 to 1000 are divisible by 3 or 5? Inclusion-exclusion: floor(1000/3) + floor(1000/5) - floor(1000/15) = 333 + 200 - 66 = 467.
served_text.reason-0002: Count multiples of 3 up to 1000: floor(1000/3) = 333. Multiples of 5: floor(1000/5) = 200. Numbers counted twice are multiples of 15, the least common multiple: floor(1000/15) = 66. So the union is 333 + 200 - 66 = 467. Verify by complement: the density of numbers divisible by neither is (2/3)(4/5) = 8/15, so about 533 are excluded and 467 remain. The two agree.
served_text.reason-0003: Restate the goal: count integers in [1,1000] divisible by 3 or by 5. Plan: inclusion-exclusion, then an independent check by blocks. Derive: |A| = 333, |B| = 200, |A and B| = 66, so |A or B| = 467. Check by blocks of 15: each block contains 7 qualifying numbers (3,5,6,9,10,12,15). There are 66 full blocks giving 462, and the remainder 991..1000 contributes 993,995,996,999,1000 which is 5. Total 467. Both methods agree.
